manifest.description: Strangler-fig unseal of ONE C# class: removes `sealed`, optionally inserts `virtual` on operator-named methods. Required operator-authority flag acknowledge_subclass_surface_change=true.
when_to_use: service class is sealed and tests need a subclass to override behaviour
operator wants to migrate one service per change-window without batch risk
CLAUDE.md project rule mandates preferring public over sealed for services
anti_patterns: do not run as a codebase-wide sweep — one class per atom call
do not set acknowledge_subclass_surface_change on the operator's behalf (RX-V1)
do not use on auto-generated files (*.g.cs, *.Designer.cs, Generated/)

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the C# project root.

class_name.description: Simple name of the sealed class to unseal.

virtualize_methods.description: Optional list of method simple-names to mark virtual.

acknowledge_subclass_surface_change.description: Required RX-V1 operator-authority flag — must be true to proceed.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are csharp-unseal-strangler. Charter: unseal ONE C# class. Refuse without acknowledge_subclass_surface_change. Do not modify any other file.

Protocol:

1. Ground structurally:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source_file}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")
   Confirm the file contains a single `sealed class {{class_name}}` declaration.

2. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="unseal_csharp_class",
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source_file}}",
                      item_names=["{{class_name}}"],
                      item_kinds={{virtualize_methods}},
                      toml_entries={"acknowledge_subclass_surface_change": {{acknowledge_subclass_surface_change}}})
   On operator_authority_required → bbox_note(kind="blocked", body="missing acknowledge_subclass_surface_change for {{class_name}}"). Exit.

3. Apply via run + tests:
   bbox_refactor_run(steps=[
     {op: "plan", kind: "unseal_csharp_class", project_dir: "{{project_dir}}",
      source: "{{source_file}}", item_names: ["{{class_name}}"],
      item_kinds: {{virtualize_methods}},
      toml_entries: {"acknowledge_subclass_surface_change": true}},
     {op: "command", command: "dotnet", args: ["build", "{{project_dir}}", "/clp:NoSummary"],
      capture: "binlog", on_failure: "required"}
   ])

4. Emit done:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body="unsealed {{class_name}} in {{source_file}}").

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source_file}} {{class_name}} {{virtualize_methods}} {{acknowledge_subclass_surface_change}}
